text: Route prefix: /lab. Manages the complete laboratory workflow: master data, test ordering, specimen collection, results entry, and lab material dispensing. Core components: Lab sections, tests, panels, reference ranges, lab requests/items, lab results, and dispensing.

Route: lab.sections (permission: lab.manage). Laboratory sections/departments: Clinical Chemistry, Hematology, Microbiology, Urinalysis, Immunology/Serology, Coagulation, Blood Banking/Transfusion, Histopathology, Cytology, etc. Fields: id, name, code, description, is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns. Used as requesting_department_id in lab requests.

Route: lab.units (permission: lab.manage). Measurement units for lab tests: mmol/L, mg/dL, g/dL, cmm (cells per cubic mm), %, IU/L, U/L, etc. Fields: id, name, abbreviation, system (metric/imperial/none), is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns. Each lab test references a unit_id.

Route: lab.specimen-types (permission: lab.manage). Types of specimens collected: Whole Blood (EDTA), Serum (Red Top), Plasma (Citrate/Blue Top), Urine (Random/Fasting/24hr), Stool, Sputum, Swab (Throat/Nasopharyngeal/Vaginal), Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF), Synovial Fluid, Ascitic Fluid, Pleural Fluid, Pericardial Fluid, Bronchoalveolar Lavage, Bone Marrow, Tissue/Biopsy, etc. Fields: id, name, code, description, collection_instructions (text), is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns.

Route: lab.instruments (permission: lab.manage). Laboratory instruments/analyzers: Automated Chemistry Analyzer, Hematology Analyzer, Coagulation Analyzer, Microbiology Incubator, Microscope, Centrifuge, etc. Fields: id, name, code, manufacturer, model, serial_number, installation_date, calibration_date, next_calibration_date, status (Operational/Under Maintenance/Out of Service), is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns. Instruments can be linked to tests.

Route: lab.tests (permission: lab.manage). Individual laboratory tests. This is the core test catalog. Each test record defines the test's properties, charges, and result structure. Fields: id, lab_section_id (FK), test_name, test_code, description, specimen_type_id (FK), unit_id (FK), standard_charge (float - used for billing when ordered via OPD/ER/inpatient), normal_range_low (float, nullable), normal_range_high (float, nullable), reference_range_text (string - textual reference range notes), is_coding_required (bool - if true, requires ICD10/ SNOMED coding), is_micro_result_required (bool), is_parametric_result (bool - numeric lab result), parametric_unit_id (FK to lab_units, for numeric results), parametric_decimal_places (int, default 2), is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns.

items: Example tests by section: Hematology - Complete Blood Count (CBC), WBC Differential, Platelet Count, ESR, PT/INR, aPTT; Clinical Chemistry - Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS), Random Blood Sugar (RBS), HbA1c, Creatinine, BUN, ALT, AST, ALP, Total Bilirubin, Direct Bilirubin, Total Protein, Albumin, Globulin, Total Cholesterol, Triglycerides, HDL, LDL, Uric Acid, Sodium, Potassium, Chloride, Bicarbonate; Microbiology - Gram Stain, Culture & Sensitivity (C&S), AFB Smear, Urine Culture; Urinalysis - Urinalysis (Routine), Urine Pregnancy Test; Immunology - ASO Titer, CRP, Rheumatoid Factor, Hepatitis B Panel, Hepatitis C Antibody, HIV Ag-Ab, VDRL/RPR, TSH, T3, T4.
Each test has: a standard_charge (used for billing when ordered), a unit (mmol/L, %, etc.), optional normal ranges (low/high), and a reference range text.
parametric_result tests have numeric results with decimal precision. non-parametric tests have text/micro results (e.g. Gram Stain = 'Gram Positive Cocci in Clusters').
Tests are ordered via OPD/ER/inpatient orders (LabRequest + LabRequestItem), NOT by directly creating lab results.

text: Route: lab.panels (permission: lab.manage). Test panels/batteries: CBC with Differential, Fasting Lipid Profile, Liver Function Test (LFT), Renal Function Test (RFT), Fasting Blood Sugar Panel, Urinalysis Complete, Thyroid Function Test, etc. Panels group multiple tests together for convenient ordering. Fields: id, name, code, description, test_ids (JSON array of lab_tests.id), is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns.

Route: lab.reference-ranges (permission: lab.manage). Age and sex-specific reference ranges for tests. Fields: id, lab_test_id (FK), age_min (int, nullable), age_max (int, nullable), sex (string - Male/Female/Both), range_low (float), range_high (float), unit_id (FK), notes (string), is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns. Reference ranges override the test's default normal_range_low/high for specific demographics.
Flow: Order placed (from OPD/ER/inpatient) -> LabRequest created -> Specimen collected -> Results entered -> Results viewed by requesting doctor.

items: id - Primary key.
tenant_id - FK to hospitals.id.
lab_request_code - Code: 'LR-' + 5-digit sequence (e.g. LR-00001). Generated by placeLabOrder().
opd_consultation_id - FK to opd_consultations.id (for OPD orders; nullable otherwise).
er_admission_id - FK to er_admissions.id (for ER orders; nullable otherwise).
admission_id - FK to admissions.id (for inpatient orders; nullable otherwise).
patient_id - FK to patients.id. The patient being tested.
requesting_department_id - FK to departments.id. Typically the 'Laboratory' department or the ordering clinic's department.
requesting_doctor_id - FK to health_care_professionals.id. The doctor who ordered the tests.
request_datetime - DateTime. When the order was placed.
priority - String: Stat, Urgent, Routine, Standby. Default: 'Routine'.
request_notes - Text (nullable). Clinical notes for the lab technologist.
specimen_collected_datetime - DateTime (nullable). When the specimen was actually collected.
specimen_collected_by - String (nullable). Who collected the specimen.
status - Request status: Pending, Specimen Collected, In Progress, Results Ready, Verified, Cancelled.
total_charge - Float. Sum of all LabRequestItem charge_amounts.
created_by / created_date - Audit columns.
updated_by / updated_date - Audit columns.
history - Soft delete flag (1=active).
is_active - Active flag.
id - Primary key.
lab_request_id - FK to lab_requests.id.
item_type - String: 'Test' (individual lab test). May also include 'Panel' types.
lab_test_id - FK to lab_tests.id (for item_type='Test').
test_name - String. Denormalized test name (copied from lab_tests at creation).
charge_amount - Float. The test's standard_charge at time of order.
lab_result - Text (nullable, max 4000). The result entered by the lab technologist (text result for non-parametric tests or micro results).
lab_result_number - Float (nullable). Numeric result for parametric tests.

result_interpretation - String (nullable). Auto-computed or manually set: 'Within Normal Limits', 'Above Reference Range', 'Below Reference Range', 'Critical - High', 'Critical - Low', 'Not Applicable'.
is_reviewed - Boolean. Whether the pathologist/lab supervisor has reviewed this result.
reviewed_by - FK to users/HCPs (nullable).
reviewed_date - DateTime (nullable).
created_by / created_date - Audit columns.
updated_by / updated_date - Audit columns.

text: From OPD Consultation (placeLabOrder) or ER Admission. See sections 6.5.1 and 7.6 for the full order placement flow. Summary:

items: Doctor selects tests from the lab tests catalog in the order modal.
For each selected test: a LabRequestItem is created with lab_test_id, test_name, charge_amount (from test->standard_charge).
LabRequest is created with request_code = 'LR-' + 5-digit sequence, status = 'Pending'.
The request appears in Lab > Results for the lab technologist to process.

text: Route: lab.results (permission: lab.result). The lab results page shows all lab requests for the current tenant with their items and results status.

items: Filters: by status (All, Pending, Specimen Collected, In Progress, Results Ready, Verified), by priority (Stat, Urgent, Routine), by date range.
Search by patient name, lab request code, or doctor name.
For each request: shows patient, request code, ordering doctor, priority, status, date, total charge.
Clicking into a request shows all LabRequestItems with their test names and current result status.
Results Entry: For each item, the lab technologist enters:
- lab_result (text): the result string (e.g. '4.5', 'Gram Positive Cocci in Clusters', 'Negative', '12-15 HPF').
- lab_result_number (numeric): for parametric tests, the numeric value.

- result_interpretation: auto-computed by comparing lab_result_number against the test's normal_range_low/high (or the demographic-specific reference range). Options: 'Within Normal Limits', 'Above Reference Range', 'Below Reference Range', 'Critical - High', 'Critical - Low'.
- is_reviewed: marks whether the result has been reviewed by a supervisor.
Updating a result: sets updated_by/updated_date. If is_reviewed is checked, sets reviewed_by/reviewed_date.
When all items have results entered, the request status can advance to 'Results Ready'.
Verified status: when the pathologist/supervisor verifies the results, status becomes 'Verified' and the requesting doctor can view them.

text: Route: lab.results.print ({labRequest}, permission: lab.result). Generates a PDF via DomPDF showing the complete lab request with all results.

items: PDF includes: Lab request header (request code, patient name, age, sex, status), ordering doctor and department, request date, priority, specimen type, collection date/time and collector.
Results table: test name, result (numeric + unit), reference range, interpretation, status (Pending/Reviewed/Verified).
Verified by and verification date (if reviewed).
The PDF is downloadable and printable for patient records and doctor review.

text: Route: lab.dispensing (permission: lab.dispense). Dispensing lab materials/consumables to users. Similar to pharmacy dispensing but for lab supplies. Tracks which lab materials are issued to which user/department, with quantities and dates.

Route prefix: /radiology. Manages radiology imaging: master data, exam ordering, image acquisition, results entry, radiologic technologist workflow, and DICOM/PACS integration. Core components: modalities, body parts, exam types, radiology requests/items, radiology results, and dispensing.

Route: radiology.modalities (permission: radiology.manage). Imaging modalities: X-Ray, Ultrasound (US), Computed Tomography (CT Scan), Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), Fluoroscopy, Mammography, Nuclear Medicine, PET Scan, Interventional Radiology, etc. Fields: id, name, code, description, room_number (optional), is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns.

Route: radiology.body-parts (permission: radiology.manage). Anatomical body parts/regions examined: Head, Face, Neck, Chest, Abdomen, Pelvis, Spine (Cervical/Thoracic/Lumbar), Upper Extremity (Left/Right), Lower Extremity (Left/Right), etc. Fields: id, name, code, description, parent_body_part_id (for hierarchical parts), is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns. Body parts are used to categorize exam types.

Route: radiology.exam-types (permission: radiology.manage). Radiology exam types. Each exam type belongs to a modality and a body part, and defines the exam's properties and charges. Fields: id, modality_id (FK to radiology_modalities), body_part_id (FK to radiology_body_parts), exam_name, exam_code, description, standard_charge (float), is_coding_required (bool), isoc_clinical_indication_required (bool), premium_service (bool), is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns.

items: Examples: X-Ray Chest PA (Chest X-Ray), X-Ray Abdomen Supine, Ultrasonography Abdomen Complete, CT Brain Plain, CT Chest with Contrast, MRI Brain Plain, MRI Lumbar Spine, Mammography Bilateral.
Each exam has a standard_charge for billing, modality, body part, and optional clinical indication requirement.
Exam types are ordered via RadiologyRequest + RadiologyRequestItem from OPD/ER/inpatient.
id - Primary key.
tenant_id - FK to hospitals.id.
radiology_request_code - Code: 'Rad-' + 5-digit sequence (e.g. Rad-00001). Generated by placeRadiologyOrder().
opd_consultation_id - FK to opd_consultations.id (nullable).
er_admission_id - FK to er_admissions.id (nullable).
admission_id - FK to admissions.id (nullable).
patient_id - FK to patients.id.
requesting_department_id - FK to departments.id.
requesting_person - String. Name of the person requesting (doctor or staff).
requesting_doctor_id - FK to health_care_professionals.id.
clinical_indication - Text (nullable). Clinical reason for the exam (required for ICSC-compliant exams).
priority - String: Stat, Urgent, Routine. Default 'Routine'.
status - Request status: Pending, Scheduled, In Progress, Completed, Results Ready, Reported, Cancelled.
exam_type_id - FK to radiology_exam_types (set when exam is scheduled/completed).
technologist_id - FK to health_care_professionals.id (nullable). The rad tech who performed the exam.
radiologist_id - FK to health_care_professionals.id (nullable). The radiologist who interpreted the study.
exam_datetime - DateTime (nullable). When the exam was performed.
total_charge - Float. Sum of exam charges.
created_by / created_date - Audit columns.
updated_by / updated_date - Audit columns.
history - Soft delete flag (1=active).
is_active - Active flag.
id - Primary key.
radiology_request_id - FK to radiology_requests.id.
exam_type_id - FK to radiology_exam_types.
exam_name - String. Denormalized exam name.
modality - String. Denormalized modality name.
body_part - String. Denormalized body part name.
charge_amount - Float. Exam's standard_charge at time of order.
radiologist_findings - Text (nullable, max 10000). The radiologist's interpretation/findings.
radiology_impression - Text (nullable, max 10000). The radiologist's impression/conclusion.
is_reviewed - Boolean. Whether the report has been reviewed/finalized.
reviewed_by - FK (nullable).
reviewed_date - DateTime (nullable).
created_by / created_date - Audit columns.
updated_by / updated_date - Audit columns.

text: From OPD/ER/Inpatient (placeRadiologyOrder). See 6.5.4 and 7.6 for full flow. Summary:

items: Doctor selects exam types from the radiology catalog.
For each selected exam: RadiologyRequestItem created with exam_type_id, exam_name, modality, body_part, charge_amount.
RadiologyRequest created with request_code = 'Rad-' + 5-digit sequence, status = 'Pending'.
Clinical indication can be added for ICSC-compliant exams.
The request appears in Radiology > Results for the rad tech to schedule/perform.

text: Route: radiology.results (permission: radiology.result). The radiology results page shows all radiology requests.

items: Filters: by status, priority, date range, modality.
Search by patient name, request code, ordering doctor.

Status flow: Pending -> Scheduled (exam scheduled for a slot) -> In Progress (exam being performed) -> Completed (exam done, images acquired) -> Results Ready (images available, awaiting radiologist) -> Reported (radiologist has finalized report) -> Cancelled.
Exam Performance: When the rad tech performs the exam, they set technologist_id, exam_datetime, and advance status to 'Completed'.
Results Entry: The radiologist enters radiologist_findings (the detailed findings narrative) and radiology_impression (the conclusion). Sets is_reviewed=true, reviewed_by, reviewed_date.
When findings + impression are entered, status advances to 'Reported'.
For exams requiring a contrast study, the contrast type, dose, and any adverse reactions can be noted in the findings.

text: Route: radiology.results.print ({radiologyRequest}, permission: radiology.result). Generates a PDF via DomPDF.

items: PDF includes: Exam header (request code, patient name, age, sex, status), ordering doctor and department, request date, priority, clinical indication, exam type name, modality, body part, exam date/time.
Radiologist findings (the detailed interpretation narrative).
Radiology impression (the conclusion).
Reported by and report date.
The PDF serves as the official radiology report for the patient's medical record and doctor review.

text: Route: radiology.dicom (permission: radiology.manage). The application supports DICOM/PACS integration for image management.

items: DICOM images acquired by the modalities are stored in the PACS and linked to the radiology request/exam.

The PACS API allows: registering new studies, linking studies to radiology requests, retrieving image lists for a request, downloading DICOM images, and querying studies by patient, exam date, or modality.

Image access in the UI: from the radiology results page, the PACS link shows the list of DICOM series for the exam. Users can launch the PACS viewer (web-based DICOM viewer) directly to view the images.
For modalities without DICOM connectivity, image files can be manually uploaded and linked to the exam.
The DICOM/PACS integration ensures that radiology images are properly archived, linked to the correct patient and exam, and accessible for clinical review and legal medical record purposes.

text: Route: radiology.dispensing (permission: radiology.dispense). Dispensing radiology supplies/contrast media to procedures. Tracks contrast agents, consumables, and supplies issued for imaging exams.
